subject: SIG/CAIQ: Request for encryption snapshot & key rotation artifacts
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita@brookline-fin.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Mahoney <peter.mahoney@brookline-fin.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ: compact encryption snapshot request

Hi Connor,

We're running a focused SIG/CAIQ review and need a compact set of artifacts around your encryption and KMS controls to share with our InfoSec team and auditors. Can you provide the following for Brookline Financial's evaluation?

- Key rotation history (timestamps of rekey events) for the last 12 months, preferably in CSV or small matrix form.
- A snapshot of KMS metadata (key IDs, policy names, roles with crypto operator access).
- HSM attestation summary (seal status, vendor cert, and whether split-operator ceremonies were used).
- Confirmation of in-transit TLS configs and any exceptions for legacy clients.
- Any emergency rewrap or ad-hoc rekey events in the past 12 months with a short explanation.

We're trying to keep the request compact — a 1–2 page summary + a small archive of logs and a CSV for rotation events would be ideal. Do you have a timeline for delivery? Our auditor needs this by EOD 7/18 if possible.

Thanks,
Anita
Anita Shah
Security Operations Lead
Brookline Financial

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita@brookline-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: compact encryption snapshot request

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a compact package that fits what your auditor needs. High-level plan:

1) Rotation matrix CSV with event timestamps and brief reason codes (routine rotation / emergency rewrap).
2) KMS metadata snapshot (redacted tenant ids) exported as a zip.
3) HSM attestation summary (PDF) with vendor cert and whether ceremonies used.
4) Short TLS/in-transit confirmation note (cipher suites, TLS termination points).

Marissa from Crypto Ops will produce the artifacts; Irene will confirm the redaction and SOC2-friendly wording. Ben is on the thread for pricing/any contract questions the auditor might raise.

We can deliver a secure Drive link to a zipped package and a separate CSV for rotation events by EOD 2029-07-16 (today). If you need the raw logs via SFTP instead, we'll coordinate a one-time transfer.

Do you prefer the rotation CSV to include operator usernames or just role names?

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita@brookline-fin.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2029 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: compact encryption snapshot request

Anita — attaching the compact artifacts we discussed. Attachments (stubs):
- rotation_matrix.csv (columns: key_id, rotation_timestamp_utc, rotation_type, initiated_by_role)
- hsm_attestation-summary.pdf (vendor cert, ceremony type, current seal status)
- redwood_kms_snapshot_20290716.zip (contains kms_metadata.json, acl_export.csv — tenant ids redacted)

Notes and clarifications:
- We redacted tenant identifiers and replaced with tenant markers (T-<redacted>).
- Operator access is exported as role names only (no individual usernames), per your request — if the auditor needs operator usernames for a sample, we can provide a vetted subset under an NDA.
- Emergency rewraps in the last 12 months: 1 event (2029-01-14T03:22:11Z) marked as "emergency_rewrap" in the CSV with a short justification (hardware maintenance + verified key integrity). No customer keys were exposed; rewrap was internal to the HSM cluster and logged in the operator shift logs.
- TLS/in-transit: we terminate TLS at the regional load balancers using TLS 1.2+ with strong cipher suites (ECDHE_AESGCM), and internal transit between nodes uses mTLS. We do not have any planned exceptions; any older client endpoints are proxied and TLS upgraded at the edge.

Access instructions: the Drive link below contains the zip; password will be sent to you over verified channel (we use a separate DocuSign / secure message for passwords). Please acknowledge once you can download.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-enc-snapshot-20290716
(same link will expire in 14 days)

If you want the raw HSM operator shift logs for a specific month, indicate which month and we'll prepare a redacted extract.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff Crypto Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Anita Shah <anita@brookline-fin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Mahoney <peter.mahoney@brookline-fin.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2029 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: compact encryption snapshot request

Marissa / Connor — received the Drive link and the CSV preview looks good. Quick follow-ups for the auditor:

1) Can you provide the exact UTC timestamps for all rekey events in machine-readable ISO format? The CSV looks to have them but our auditor wants a single-column export with timestamps for ingestion.
2) For the emergency rewrap on 2029-01-14, can you add a 2–3 sentence summary of root cause and the mitigation steps taken (suitable for inclusion in the SOC2 narrative).
3) Confirm whether any keys were migrated between HSM clusters or physically exported (we assume not, but need an explicit statement).

If you can drop these three items into the same Drive folder before EOD 7/18, we should be set for the auditor. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Thanks,
Anita Shah
Security Operations Lead
Brookline Financial
